report.body:
Police took a driver and two other people to the Civil Police station in Água
Clara after an operation on 4 November 2026. Military and Civil Police
found 59 tablets of material resembling cannabis, weighing about 54 kilograms. The operation began after Military Police received information that a man
was selling drugs using a white VW Gol in the Jardim das Palmeiras
neighbourhood.

Officers located the car and pursued the driver for several blocks before
stopping him. They found a portion of suspected cocaine in the car and
cannabis portions, a precision scale, packaging materials and money at the
suspect's home. A joint Military and Civil Police team subsequently located
two other people at a snack bar before finding the 59 tablets. Those
involved were taken to the Civil Police station for legal procedures.

report.body:
Mossos d'Esquadra arrested seven men aged 29 to 55 at an industrial warehouse in
Cabanes, Girona, on 1 October 2026 on suspicion of involvement in a
drug-trafficking organisation. Officers seized 8,025 kilograms of hashish
at the warehouse. The seized hashish was valued at more than €16.2 million
on the illicit market.

Police began investigating in June after intercepting a van carrying about 2,400
kilograms of hashish in Viladecans and linked its cargo to the Cabanes
warehouse. Surveillance identified people and vehicles visiting the
warehouse and apparent loading and unloading despite no observed business
activity. Police entered after observing repeated movements, the arrival of
an articulated lorry and people apparently replacing vehicle number plates.

Inside, officers found seven people unloading pallets from the trailer,
allegedly intending to transfer the hashish to vans for distribution. The
hashish was concealed among merchandise in large raffia sacks containing rubber
crumbs. During the search, police also found a firearm in one of the
detainees' vans. The detainees were brought before the Figueres court, and
the investigation remained open.

report.title: Ceuta truck driver held in pretrial detention after hashish seizure
report.summary: A judge ordered a truck driver held in pretrial detention after UDYCO officers found bags of hashish hidden in his vehicle at Ceuta port. Reports differ on the estimated weight, and no official figure was given.
report.body:
Spain's UDYCO drug unit arrested a truck driver at the port of Ceuta carrying a
stash of hashish hidden in a sophisticated false bottom. Officers
intercepted the truck on the port road at the Muelle de Poniente and searched it
with support from the UPR prevention unit and the canine group. They found
the hashish and detained the driver, showing him the drugs found in the vehicle
he was driving.

The truck appeared empty and was heading toward boarding for Spain when a
specialist drugs dog alerted, prompting an exhaustive hours-long search inside
and outside the vehicle. After the hours-long detailed inspection, officers
found a large number of bags full of hashish inside the truck's structure.
Officers recovered numerous bags of hashish from the trailer's false bottom,
with first estimates putting the haul above 300 kilograms although police gave
no official weight. The submitted account describes the seizure as about
300 kilograms of hashish arriving from Morocco.

The handcuffed driver was taken to police headquarters and placed under
investigation for an offence against public health. On 15 November, a judicial authority ordered the driver held in pretrial detention over an offence against public health. Police link the
operation to open UDYCO investigations into groups moving hashish from Ceuta to
mainland Spain in heavy vehicles with hidden compartments.

report.body:
A Ukrainian driver was sentenced to 24 months in prison by the Tarbes criminal
court on 1 October 2026 after customs officers found cannabis in his vehicle. The court also banned him from French territory for ten years.

Customs officers stopped the driver in the evening of 28 September at
Saint-Lary-Soulan in the Hautes-Pyrénées and seized 32.8 kg of cannabis.
The court ordered the confiscation of the cannabis, along with 405 euros in
cash, two phones and a computer. It imposed a customs fine of 131,200 euros
for transporting drugs without proper documentation and a further 405 euros for
customs money laundering, a total of 131,605 euros.

At the hearing, the judge told the defendant that he could be more useful to his
country on his return than by smuggling in France.

International Airport after finding suspected cannabis buds in his carry-on

of HK$5 million and life imprisonment. Customs said it would use risk

A court in Mykolaiv sentenced a 51-year-old local man to nine years in prison
after finding him guilty of cannabis cultivation and making and storing drugs
for sale. He partly admitted guilt during the trial, according to the
regional prosecutor's office. The verdict had not yet entered into force
when police announced the sentence.

Police said officers discovered the man's activities in July 2026 and searched
his home under a warrant. They seized 14 cannabis plants and more than 10
kilograms of dried cannabis, the regional prosecutor's office said at the time. Investigators said he grew plants in his garden, tending, weeding and
watering them. Police said he dried some harvested plants in the attic and
put other material in glass jars for storage and, according to investigators,
sale.

Officers detained him and notified him of suspicion of drug offences and
cannabis cultivation. A court ordered pre-trial detention with bail set at
133,120 hryvnias, prosecutors said in July. The seized material was sent
for forensic examination, police said.

report.body:
Saratoga County sheriff's deputies arrested Kevin C. Wilbur of Brushton and
Quinton L. Carle of Bombay after a traffic stop on the Northway in Clifton Park,
New York. Each man was charged with first-degree criminal possession of
cannabis. The sheriff's office said deputies seized 489 pounds of cannabis,
about 221.8 kilograms.

The stop occurred at about 2:28 p.m. on Interstate 87, according to Saratoga
TODAY. Deputies stopped the vehicle for following too closely and having
insufficient tail lamps, and Wilbur was cited for both traffic violations.
The men were arraigned in Clifton Park Town Court before Judge Jennifer Jeram. Wilbur was remanded to Saratoga County Jail, while Carle was released on
his own recognizance pending further proceedings.

report.body:
Kern County deputies arrested Rogelio Lorenzo Francisca, 32, during a cannabis
investigation in Taft, California. The sheriff's office said he was
arrested on suspicion of cultivation, marijuana for sale, conspiracy and
delaying, resisting or obstructing arrest, and booked into the Taft jail.

Deputies eradicated 660 marijuana plants during the October 8 search on Highway
119 in Taft. The sheriff's office said dangerous pesticides were found at
the grow site. Taft substation deputies executed the warrant with
assistance from the sheriff's High Intensity Drug Trafficking Areas task force
and the Taft Police Department. The sheriff's office said its investigation
remained active.
